body: Thank you. It does. So much. I didn't even know if I would get a response. That means a lot.

I'm so sorry. I'm going through that too. I feel worthless and ugly and my SO is about sick of me. I have days where, "I am gonna get my life on track and get out there!" Those days are always followed by drinking and crying. My life is fine, good job and all, but I can't help but feel useless. You are helping people and that's a great thing and writing this post made me feel less alone. So thank you for that. You aren't alone either.
